title: Taking Regular Breaks at Work
paragraphs: Bekerja berjam-jam di mejanya tanpa jeda, Zain mulai mengalami sakit kepala dan nyeri leher yang sering menjelang pertengahan sebagian besar hari kerjanya, pola yang ia asumsikan sekadar tak terhindarkan mengingat pekerjaannya.

Sebuah ceramah kesehatan perusahaan memperkenalkannya pada kebiasaan sederhana: berdiri dan meregangkan tubuh selama lima menit setiap jam, sesuatu yang awalnya ia abaikan sebagai tidak perlu mengingat jadwalnya yang sibuk.
Setelah dengan enggan mencobanya selama seminggu, Zain menyadari sakit kepalanya jauh lebih jarang terjadi, dan ia merasa jauh lebih waspada di sore hari, saat ia biasanya paling sulit fokus.
Kini ia mengatur pengingat pelan di ponselnya setiap jam, menggunakan jeda singkat itu untuk berjalan ke jendela, mengisi ulang botol airnya, atau sekadar meregangkan punggung dan bahunya.
Zain memberi tahu rekan-rekan kerjanya bahwa perubahan kecil ini hampir tidak menghabiskan waktunya, namun mengembalikan energi yang ia asumsikan sekadar hilang karena tuntutan pekerjaannya.
answerKey: Working long hours at his desk without pause, Zain began experiencing frequent headaches and neck pain by the middle of most workdays, a pattern he assumed was simply unavoidable given his job. A company health talk introduced him to a simple habit: standing up and stretching for five minutes every hour, something he initially dismissed as unnecessary given his busy schedule. After reluctantly trying it for one week, Zain noticed his headaches occurred far less often, and he felt noticeably more alert during the afternoon, when he usually struggled most with focus. He now sets a quiet reminder on his phone every hour, using the short break to walk to the window, refill his water bottle, or simply stretch his back and shoulders. Zain tells his colleagues that this small change cost him almost nothing in time, yet gave him back energy he had assumed was simply lost to the demands of his job.
